snippet.title: Indie Game - Pages of Time: Prologue
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2207540/Pages_of_Time_Prologue/

The English version of our game Pages of Time is finally out on Steam! Come play it now! 🥳

Pages of Time is a 2D platformer puzzle game where you play as a witch who controls the magic of time. Set in a beautiful and magnificent magic academy, you'll be able to utilize your time-recording and rewinding skills to solve various puzzles.

Check it out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2207540/Pages_of_Time_Prologue/
